_comment: Standard SG6311A frequency bands for the PADB Viewer segment stepper (Segment step -> Named bands). Values are in Hz and auto-convert to the data's x-axis unit. Copy into a results folder next to the .parquet, or rely on the viewer's bundled default. Bands: DAC 9 kHz-8 MHz, Low 8-375 MHz, Mid 375-3200 MHz, High 3200 MHz-20 GHz.
